title: Understanding Cross Validation
text: In 8-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$8$$ parts. Each part is used once as a validation set while the remaining $$7$$ parts form the training set. How many times does each data point appear in the validation set?

title: Calculating Validation Uses
text: Consider that each data point is used in the validation set once for each fold. How many folds are there?

title: Regularization Hyperparameter
text: The regularization hyperparameter is tested across multiple values to find the best fit. If you have $$11$$ different values, how many times will each value be evaluated during cross-validation?

title: Evaluating Hyperparameter Values
text: Each hyperparameter value is tested across all folds. How many folds are there in this cross-validation?
